title: AGG- aggregate: compiled value over measurements/studies (database or review row) (DRAFT_PENDING_H4)
description: schema_version 1.1.0-draft. STATUS DRAFT_PENDING_H4: not approved, not frozen, not copied into ledgers/schemas/. USDA R6 / Bognar rows map here (member lineage NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, independence_resolution SOURCE_FAMILY_ONLY). LAW: a MEASURED value 0 is admitted only with censoring.kind TRUE_ZERO (the source states a real zero, with a basis_note); 0 is never produced from a non-detect, an unreported or an unknown value.
$comment: Default realisation (Step 04 card): AGG/DRV are not separate ledgers but `evidence_level` + `parent_ids[]` on EVD export-v2 rows; this schema then validates the exported evidence-level view (id = stable view key minted by the export builder under the reserved AGG- prefix). A separate AGG ledger is a human option (H4). member_lineage_status NOT_IDENTIFIABLE => parent_ids empty and the whole source family is one node. HUB RULE (proposed, lineage contract 4.2 step 2a): a compilation / review is a hub; the compiler SRC / DOC node is NOT a connecting node when member_lineage_status is KNOWN, so independent primary studies are never merged transitively through it. PARTIAL = known parents plus an unknown remainder: the known-parent union AND the source-family node apply and independence_resolution is SOURCE_FAMILY_ONLY or UNKNOWN.

membership_screen_status.description: Cached copy (as of rule_version) of the per-compilation-family screen of the compiler's bibliography against the primary studies: BIBLIOGRAPHY_SCREENED / NOT_SCREENED (not assessed) / NOT_AVAILABLE (no bibliography to screen). Anything other than BIBLIOGRAPHY_SCREENED means a train-on-compilation / test-on-primary evaluation (or the reverse) is labelled NOT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIED where the cells share matrix family x analyte x process family and the primary's year <= the release year.

imputation.description: Source-side imputation (USDA R6: 'imputed from similar foods'). Donors stay in the same split group (transition-bootstrap contract L20).

basis_raw.description: Source wording of the basis, verbatim; null only when the source states none.

retention_definition.description: TRUE_MURPHY = Murphy et al. 1975 true retention (nutrient content of the cooked portion x cooked mass / nutrient content of the raw portion x raw mass: weight change accounted for; the card's TRUE and YIELD_ADJUSTED are the same quantity and differ only in WHO states it, which is recorded in retention_definition_evidence). APPARENT_* = concentration ratio without yield correction, WITH the basis it was computed on (fresh vs dry weight differ by the water loss, often 10-50%). TR_OR_AR_UNDISCLOSED = the source mixes true and apparent retention without marking which. UNKNOWN = not assessed. NOT_APPLICABLE = the value is not a retention.

retention_definition_evidence.description: Who states the retention definition: primary paper, a secondary source (Phenol-Explorer: a secondary snippet, D-020), inferred from the formula, or assumed by the extractor. NOT_APPLICABLE when the value is not a retention.

value_obj.description: UNKNOWN-aware value (same status vocabulary as ledgers/schemas/common QVALUE). A number is allowed only where the status says so; UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE/QUALITATIVE/CENSORED carry no number (the censoring limit lives in `censoring`). `raw` keeps the source string verbatim. `unit` is the raw unit string as printed and is never rewritten; `unit_id` (UNIT-) is the optional normalised pointer with an explicit mapping status (NOT_MAPPED / UNKNOWN keep it null; never a guessed id).

count.description: Replicate/sample count with explicit status. NOT_REPORTED = the source was read and is silent; UNKNOWN = not assessed or cannot be told. Never 0 and never a default 1.

measure.description: LOD / LOQ of the method as stated for this observation (not an observed value).

dispersion.description: Dispersion with its TYPE always stated (SD vs SE vs CI cannot be confused). NONE_REPORTED = source gives none; UNKNOWN = not assessed. Estimates from median/range (Wan et al. 2014 type) are allowed only with derivation ESTIMATED_FROM_SUMMARY, never as AS_REPORTED. `unit` null means 'same unit as the value' (VARIANCE: squared unit, state it). `n_basis` says which n the SD/SE refers to (biological vs technical; needed for SE->SD conversion; NOT_REPORTED = source silent, UNKNOWN = not assessed). `scope` PER_VALUE vs POOLED_TABLE (one pooled SEM / LSD for a whole table). `significance_raw` keeps significance letters / p text verbatim. CV_PERCENT is stored as printed (unit '%'), never converted to an SD here.

censoring.description: Censoring of ONE observation. kind NOT_REPORTED (CS-007) = no censoring information (UNKNOWN is not NON_DETECT); ND (CS-002) = reported not detected, limit may be unknown and is never zero; LT_LOD/LT_LOQ need the stated limit (limit_high); GT_CAP/GT_ULOQ/GT_STATED need limit_low; ROUNDED_INTERVAL needs the rounding `resolution` (e.g. 'nearest 5%'); RANGE_ONLY = only an interval was reported; TRUE_ZERO is allowed only with a basis_note naming why the zero is a real zero. Cross-field rules against value.status are in the parent schema. TRACE_BETWEEN_LOD_LOQ (proposed CS-011; INFOODS 'tr') = interval-censored between the stated LOD (limit_low) and LOQ (limit_high); value.status CENSORED, no number. Limits are strictly positive: a limit of 0 is not a limit and never a stand-in for a non-detect. GT_CAP together with a `resolution` (USDA: '> 100 reported as 100', rounded to the nearest 5%) keeps the cap AS PRINTED in limit_low; the analysis reads the effective bound limit_low - resolution/2 as a NEW derived quantity and never overwrites limit_low.

digitization.description: Digitisation provenance. The read uncertainty is a number > 0 or explicitly UNKNOWN (uncertainty_status UNKNOWN, uncertainty null): an unknown read uncertainty is never forced to a number and never 0. Axis scale matters (a log axis gives asymmetric / multiplicative error); calibration points, digitizer identity and the repeat-read count / inter-read SD make a read reproducible. Two independent reads are required for any TEST / SIM-VAL eligible series (THR-04K-03, a rule outside this record schema).

method_ref.description: Method/platform reference. MEAS- = analytical METHOD (never an observation). platform_raw keeps the source wording.

condition_ref.description: Condition reference (COND-). INHERITED_FROM_SAMPLE = use SMP.derived_from.condition_id; an observation-level override must be LINKED.

locator.description: Exact place in a DOC. raw_text is the verbatim cell/span/row (key required, null only when the source has no text form).

matrix.description: Same facets as EVD.matrix (non-destructive). raw_name is required (raw preserved); ingredient_id null = UNRESOLVED.

process.description: Process as in EVD.process; process_id null = UNRESOLVED.

analyte_form.description: Analyte basis/form as stated (e.g. 'ascorbic acid' vs 'ascorbic acid + dehydroascorbic acid'). NOT_REPORTED is a valid answer.

parent_union.description: Parent lineage keys of an AGG/DRV. After 08a merging every DRV must have union_status SINGLE_GROUP or MERGED_BY_PARENT_UNION (gate G08-2).

lineage.description: Cached lineage keys of one evidence-level record as of `rule_version` (authoritative assignment = the independence registry at that rule_version). study_id / lineage_root_id / split_group_id are three SEPARATE keys and are never aliased. split_group_id is EVIDENCE-plane only (pattern SPLITGRP-EVD-); a recipe-plane SPLITGRP-REC- value is rejected by this pattern (no cross-plane join). ASSIGNED rows always carry both ids (gate G08-1); independence_resolution UNKNOWN on an ASSIGNED row means the ids are a conservative best-effort component and the row is TRAIN-ONLY (never validation/calibration/test). PENDING = not yet computed (ids null, resolution UNKNOWN).
